fdroid:au.how2vote.app.name: How2Vote
fdroid:au.how2vote.app.summary: See how parties' real parliamentary voting records compare with your views.
fdroid:au.how2vote.app.description:
How2Vote is an independent, non-partisan comparison tool for Australian federal elections.
NOT A GOVERNMENT APP
How2Vote is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorised by the Australian Electoral Commission, the Parliament of Australia or any other government entity, and it does not provide or facilitate government services.
Answer propositions that parliament has actually voted on. The app shows how closely each party's recorded parliamentary votes match your positions — against the candidates on your ballot, in official ballot order. Then build your own voting plan: nothing is ranked for you and no preference is recommended. You author your own preference order.
WORKS FULLY OFFLINE
The complete dataset ships inside the app — questions, scoring and your card all work with no connection, including at a polling place with no signal. The app goes online only for what you ask it to: sending the contact form, contributing to the anonymous research if you opt in, or opening a link out to the AEC or They Vote For You.
BUILT FROM THE PARLIAMENTARY RECORD
Comparisons are built from recorded parliamentary votes (public Hansard data via They Vote For You), not campaign statements. Every proposition links to the parliamentary divisions behind it, so everything you are shown can be checked at the source.
OFFICIAL SOURCES
Every piece of electoral and parliamentary information in the app comes from these public sources, and can be checked against them. This is the complete list:
- Candidates, ballot paper order, electoral divisions and election dates — Australian Electoral Commission, 2025 federal election downloads: https://www.aec.gov.au/election/fe25/downloads-statistics.htm
- Electoral division boundaries used for the maps — Australian Electoral Commission, electoral boundaries GIS downloads: https://www.aec.gov.au/Electorates/gis/gis_datadownload.htm
- The parliamentary record the vote comparisons are drawn from (Hansard divisions) — Parliament of Australia: https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Hansard
- The compiled division-by-division voting records the app actually reads — They Vote For You, by the OpenAustralia Foundation: https://theyvoteforyou.org.au
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. Your answers and weights stay on your device.
NEUTRAL BY CONSTRUCTION
The interface is strictly two-tone, so match quality is never encoded as party colour. The scoring method is public, deterministic and reproducible, and the app is open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. https://github.com/National-Digital/how2vote.au
Authorised by General Consulting Services Pty Ltd as trustee for the Australian Business Trust, trading as National Digital, Gold Coast, Queensland.

fdroid:com.greenaddress.abcore.name: ABCore
fdroid:com.greenaddress.abcore.description:
ABCore is a wrapper for Bitcoin Core for Android.
Bitcoin Core (formerly Bitcoin-Qt) is the bitcoin daemon software based on
the original reference code by Satoshi Nakamoto. It is programmed to decide
which block chain contains valid transactions. The users of Bitcoin Core
only accept transactions for that block chain, making it the Bitcoin block
chain that everyone else wants to use.
It is these users who keep Bitcoin decentralized. They individually run
their own Bitcoin Core full nodes, and each of those full nodes separately
follows the exact same rules to decide which block chain is valid.
There's no voting or other corruptible process involved: there's just
individual software following identical rules—"math"—to evaluate identical
blocks and coming to identical conclusions about which block chain is
valid.

fdroid:de.kromke.andreas.cameradatefolde.name: Camera Date Folders

fdroid:de.kromke.andreas.cameradatefolde.description:
Sorts all photos, located in the device's camera folder, into a date specific subfolder structure. This makes it easier to transfer specific photos to a computer, e.g. via USB cable (MTP protocol).
Either keep photos inside the camera folder tree or move or copy them to a separate directory. This can also be used as a simple backup method.
Up to three levels are supported: year, month and day. The sorting can be reverted, i.e. all photos can be moved back to the base directory (but not back to the camera directory in case a destination directory is specified).
On the demand a file name prefix like "IMG_" or "PXL_" can be appended instead or completely removed. Note that this operation is not revertible.
The program does not read metadata (EXIF) from the photo files, instead it uses the data information encoded in the filenames.
To meet Google's restrictive policy, the Play Store variant of the program must use Google's proprietary Storage Access Framework when running on Android 11 or newer. As a consequence, file operations are extremely slow. This restriction partially exists also for older Android versions and not at all for the F-Droid version of the program. In this case standard file access calls can be activated alternatively, which accelerate the file operations with a factor of approximately 90 (!).

fdroid:net.retiolus.osm2gmaps.name: osm2gmaps
fdroid:net.retiolus.osm2gmaps.summary: Convert coordinates and map links between formats, services and apps
fdroid:net.retiolus.osm2gmaps.description:
osm2gmaps finds a place from whatever you have: coordinates, a grid reference, a plus code, a map link, a photo or an address. It gives you that place in every useful form: coordinates in the format you need, or the place in the map app you use.
 Every way to write a position

* National grids, shown only where they are used: British National Grid, Irish Grid, Swiss LV95, Dutch RD, French Lambert 93 and DFCI, Swedish SWEREF 99 TM.
* Pick a format with one tap and copy it with another. Hide the ones you never use.
* Reads coordinates however they are written: N/S/E/W or signs, symbols or spaces, GeoJSON and WKT, longitude first when it is obvious. Also reads Irish ITM and Swiss LV03.
* When a code can be read several ways (a locator or a geohash, two grids), shows the other readings.
* Completes local plus codes ("V75V+8Q Paris") with OpenStreetMap.
 From any map, to any map

* Opens the place or starts navigation in your map app, gives it as a link for more than 20 services, or as a QR code for another phone.
* Corrects the offset of Chinese map coordinates (GCJ-02, BD-09).
* Moves your bookmarks from one map app to another, with their lists, notes, tracks and routes: from a Google Takeout archive or a list from Organic Maps, CoMaps, OsmAnd or HERE WeGo, to Organic Maps, CoMaps, OsmAnd, Cartes IGN, Magic Earth, or a KMZ, GPX, KML, GeoJSON or Google My Maps file.
* Shows the places of a shared Google Maps list, and saves them all.
 Quick to use 
* Paste, share text or a photo, select text in any app, search an address, or use your current position.
* Shows the place on OpenStreetMap's map when you ask.
* Choose what happens when you open a map link: show the place, open it in your map app, or copy or share it.
* Keeps a history of your places, with favourites, exported to GPX, KML or JSON.
 Private by design 
* No ads, no trackers, no account. Coordinates are converted on your phone.
* The app never contacts Google, Apple or other proprietary services, except what3words with your own key. Short links go through an open-source resolver that you turn on, and can host yourself.

fdroid:webtor.app.name: Torrent Player
fdroid:webtor.app.summary: Stream and download torrents directly on Android with external media players.
fdroid:webtor.app.description:
Torrent Player is a lightweight, high-performance torrent downloader and streaming engine designed specifically for Android.
 Download torrents directly to your local storage or stream growing video files on-the-fly using your favorite external media players.
 Core Features: 
 Direct Local Storage: Single-contract download directly to local public storage ( Downloads/Webtor ) for straightforward file management.
 In-Progress Video Streaming: Stream growing video files directly to external players such as VLC, Nova Video Player, MPV, or Just Player without waiting for downloads to finish.
 Selective File Downloading: Choose specific files to prioritize or download in multi-file swarms.
 Bitfield Piece Visualizer: Interactive real-time visualizer showing piece distribution and swarm availability.
 Optimized Resource & Battery Usage: Adaptive polling back-off and a native Rust engine with bounded preparation storage.
 Modern Material 3 Interface: Intuitive UI with dynamic colors, dark theme support, and animated video preview cards.
 Direct Play: Stream a video from RAM without saving the whole file. Only each video's start and end are kept (up to 1 GB) so episodes reopen fast.
 Continue Watching and Play Next: Resume where you left off and move on to the next episode, with its start fetched in advance.
 Fast Seeking: A seek fetches the new play position first and moves late blocks to faster peers. For MP4 and MKV files, nearby keyframes are fetched ahead.
 Peer Map: Shows peer countries using an offline database bundled with the app (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0). No lookup requests are made.
 Privacy & Freedom: 
 100% Free and Open Source Software (MIT License; the engine is MPL-2.0).
 No advertising trackers, analytics, or telemetry.
 Zero advertisements.
 Direct peer-to-peer swarm connectivity (DHT, UDP trackers, TCP, uTP, WebSockets, and WebRTC).
 Network connections: 
 When the app starts, the engine automatically refreshes a cached public tracker list from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ngosang/trackerslist/master/trackers_best.txt. Successful refreshes are scheduled once per day; failed requests may be retried. This request downloads a shared list and does not send torrent hashes or user-supplied tracker URLs.
 Up to 24 additional public BitTorrent trackers are automatically added to each non-private torrent to help discover peers. Cached and built-in fallback trackers are used when the list is unavailable. Private torrents are excluded. Torrent announces share your IP address and torrent info hash with the trackers contacted.
 WebRTC peer connections use STUN servers operated by Google, Twilio, and Cloudflare to discover a public network address for connectivity. These providers can see the source IP address of STUN requests.
 Seeding is on by default: after a download completes, its verified pieces are uploaded to other peers until a share ratio of 1.0 or 60 minutes of seeding, at up to 256 KiB/s and only on Wi-Fi. Seeding pauses during playback. Turn it off or change the limits in Settings, Seeding.
 The app does not provide settings to disable public tracker-list refresh, extra public trackers, or WebRTC. This build supports arm64-v8a devices.

fdroid:xyz.deepdaikon.zoysii.name: Zoysii - Logic game
fdroid:xyz.deepdaikon.zoysii.summary: A simple logic game: find the best path to delete every number in a square space
fdroid:xyz.deepdaikon.zoysii.description:
Zoysii is a simple logic game. You are the red tile on a square board and the aim is to delete almost every tile while trying to make the most points.
It's so easy !
 Modes: 
‣ Single player: play a random match and try to get the most points.
‣ Multiplayer: play against your opponents and defeat them.
‣ Levels: use your mind to solve each level by deleting all the tiles.
 Main features: 
★ Multiplayer mode for up to 4 players on the same device
★ 70+ unique levels
★ 10+ numeral systems
★ Completely free
★ No Ads
★ Multiple languages
★ Minimalist design and dark mode
 Rules: 
The rules may seem difficult at first glance but they are not.
Anyhow, the best way to learn is by playing! Levels mode is a good place to start.
1. You are the red tile on a square board.
2. Swipe horizontally or vertically to move.
3. When you move you reduce tiles value in the direction you are going.
 - The amount of this reduction is equal to your starting point tile value.
 - But if the value of a tile would be equal to 1 or 2, there will be an increase instead of a decrease.
 - Negative numbers become positive.
 - If the value of a tile becomes equal to zero, starting tile value becomes zero too. Tiles have been "Deleted".
4. You earn as many points as the value of the deleted tiles.
5. The aim is to delete almost every tile while trying to make the most points.
6. In multiplayer matches a player can win by deleting opponent's tile.

 You can change the style and color scheme of the application to make it feel more like home.
 All customization options for documents/notebooks:

 Documents are automatically saved unless you are editing a outdated diary and have disabled this feature. Additionally, a backup of the old content is always retained. Furthermore, auto-saves do not overwrite backups, meaning your manual changes remain intact.
 Documents can be in three formats: Markdown, HTML, and plain-text.
 Documents can be exported in multiple formats to your 'Documents' or 'Desktop' folder if you enable this feature. This allows you to edit them in other applications as well.
 You can pin your favorite documents/notebooks to the sidebar for easy access.
 You can change the background, text, and border colors of the document/notebook in three different states: normal, hover, and click
 And here's the most important part! All documents are associated with a notebook, and all options can follow it. All documents/notebooks can use the default settings or follow the global settings. With them, you can to customize so many things with ease.

digiKam is an advanced open-source digital photo management application that runs on Linux,
 Windows, and MacOS. The application provides a comprehensive set of tools for importing, managing,
 editing, and sharing photos and raw files. You can use digiKam’s import capabilities to easily
 transfer photos, raw files, and videos directly from your camera and external storage devices (SD
 cards, USB disks, etc.). The application allows you to configure import settings and rules that
 process and organize imported items on-the-fly.
 digiKam organizes photos, raw files, and videos into albums. But the application also features
 powerful tagging tools that allow you to assign tags, ratings, and labels to photos and raw files.
 You can then use filtering functionality to quickly find items that match specific criteria.
 In addition to filtering functionality, digiKam features powerful searching capabilities that
 let you search the photo library by a wide range of criteria. You can search photos by tags, labels,
 rating, data, location, and even specific EXIF, IPTC, or XMP metadata. You can also combine several
 criteria for more advanced searches. digiKam rely on Exiv2 library and ExifTool to handle metadata
 tag contents from files to populate the photo library.
 digiKam can handle raw files, and the application uses the excellent LibRaw library for decoding
 raw files. The library is actively maintained and regularly updated to include support for the
 latest camera models. digiKam can also manage video files for cataloging purpose, and the application
 uses the FFmpeg backends to extract metadata and play media.
 The application provides a comprehensive set of editing tools. This includes basic tools for
 adjusting colors, cropping, and sharpening as well as advanced tools for, curves adjustment, panorama
 stitching, and much more. A special tool based on Lensfun library permit to apply lens corrections
 automatically on images. The famous Gmic-Qt plugin is also available with more than 600 filters
 to extend your creativity. All editing operations in digiKam are versioned.
 Extended functionality in digiKam is implemented via a set of tools based of plugins mechanism
 (named DPlugins for digiKam Plugins). Plugins can be written to import and export contents to remote
 web-services, add new features to edit image, and batch process photo.
 Features:
 Organization of photos in albums and sub-albums (with tags and comments support)
 Support for Exif, Iptc, Xmp, Makernotes
 SQLite or Mysql powered storage for the album contents and its metadata with advanced search
 tools
 Support for filtering and sorting albums
 Import from more than 1100 digital camera devices

firefox-addons:3114647.name: PrivacyNotes
firefox-addons:3114647.summary: Save web pages as encrypted notes or bookmarks, and copy your logins, cards and SSH keys from your PrivacyNotes vault.
firefox-addons:3114647.description:
PrivacyNotes in your browser. Save the page you are reading to your PrivacyNotes account, and copy or fill your PrivacyNotes logins for the site you are on.
SAVE PAGES
- Save the page as a note, with its main text and pictures, or as a bookmark.
- Save only the text you selected.
- It reads the tab you have open, so it also saves pages behind a login.
- Use the right-click menu, or the keyboard: Alt+Shift+P saves the page as a note, Alt+Shift+G makes a password and copies it, Alt+Shift+K locks the vault.
YOUR VAULT IN THE BROWSER
- See the logins, cards, SSH keys and bookmarks from your PrivacyNotes vault, with the ones for this site first.
- Copy a username, password or 2FA code with one click. The clipboard is cleared after 30 seconds if it still holds what you copied.
- Choose Fill, or press Alt+Shift+L, and it types the login for the site you are on into the page.
- Make a strong password with the same generator as the app.
- It never fills forms by itself.
- Unlock with a PIN, or with your fingerprint or face where your browser supports it. It locks again after the time you choose.
HOW IT KEEPS YOUR NOTES SAFE
The extension never holds the key that opens your notes. It locks each clip before it leaves your browser, with a key only your apps can open, and one of your apps turns it into a note at its next sync. Your logins reach the extension as a second encrypted copy under a separate key that opens nothing else.
GET STARTED
Open Settings > Extension in PrivacyNotes, pick what the extension may do, then choose Make a code. Paste the one-time code into the extension. It needs a PrivacyNotes account: https://privacynotes.app/

 How to remove social media with AdGuard?

firefox-addons:2927543.description: Video Downloader is a simple and powerful extension that lets you download videos from a wide range of websites directly to your device. Whether you're watching tutorials, entertainment, or educational content, this tool makes saving videos effortless.

firefox-addons:2686610.name: Ezy Photo Tab & Custom Web Search
firefox-addons:2686610.summary: Add the Ezy Photo Tab & Custom Web Search extension and click the icon on your toolbar to access editing sites & Yahoo search
firefox-addons:2686610.description:
This extension gives you a fresh browser experience by configuring it with Ezy Photo Tab & Custom Web Search
Easily crop, flip or rotate photographs from your gallery. Resize images for Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest & other social media posts in a jiffy!
This easy-to-use extension also offers you Yahoo search. Easily search for images, videos, and websites and access quality search results in seconds.
This add-on is using Yahoo as a search provider.
Have a suggestion on how we could improve your experience? Please share your feedback. You can uninstall the extension if you are not satisfied with the product.
I confirm that I have read and agree to abide by the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service of Ezy Photo Tab & Custom Web Search and by clicking the button above I agree to install this extension.
Yahoo is a registered trademark of Yahoo Inc.
Our Privacy Policy:
 ezyphototab.com is a product offered by Innover Online Media Group Ltd. We provide users with ease of access to information and widgets from their browser. Our Privacy Policy is important for us to continue providing the users with the best possible all-round experience.
Here’s a summary of user data that our add-on collects and how we use this information:
 IP address:
We collect your IP address when you use the photo and video editing features, background removal and logo related features on the tool offered by our extension. We anonymise your IP address and do not trace it back to you. We only use this information for analytics and reporting purposes. You can opt-out of sharing the above information with us, however, you will only be able to access limited features.
 Technical data:
Technical information (such as domain name and user agent ) is also collected by the add-on to plan product upgrades and help with fraud detection. This data is not personally identifiable and is used for optimization purposes and cannot be used to identify users. 
 Information you explicitly share with us:
We collect and process any information including but not limited to files, images and videos that you provide while using photo and video editing features, background removal and logo related features on the tool available on our extension to return relevant results. We may also collect information that you may choose to provide us (such as your name, telephone number and/or email address) if submitted by you as part of a feedback form, crash report, enhancement suggestion or other communication from you to us. This information is only used to respond to user queries or concerns and will not be shared with any third party.
Privacy Policy: https://ezyphototab.com/pictab/privacypolicy_ff.html 
Terms of Service: https://ezyphototab.com/pictab/termsofservice_ff.html

firefox-addons:3004502.name: ColorBlind Accessibility Filter
firefox-addons:3004502.summary: Modify webpage colors to improve accessibility for colorblind individuals
firefox-addons:3004502.description: ColorBlind Accessibility Filter is a Firefox add-on that applies real-time color filters to any webpage, helping people with color vision deficiencies browse the web more comfortably. With a single click, users can switch between four filter modes tailored to the most common types of color blindness.

firefox-addons:2763564.name: Break Down the Walls
firefox-addons:2763564.summary: Break Down the Walls streamlines your access to Anna's Archive.
firefox-addons:2763564.description:
This extension streamlines accessing and downloading scientific articles and books. Here's a breakdown of its features:
Scientific Articles: Clicking the toolbar button or using the keyboard shortcut on an article page will open the article on Anna's Archive.
Books on Amazon, Google Books, or Goodreads: Pressing the toolbar button or using the keyboard shortcut searches for the book on Anna's Archive, showing the search results.
Customizable Mirror: Anna's Archive is reached through https://annas-archive.gl/ by default. If that mirror is down or blocked, set a different one in the extension preferences.
Changing the Keyboard Shortcut: Navigate to about:addons and click on the gear icon to select "Manage Extension Shortcuts".
The icon is made by Umeicon from www.flaticon.com .

firefox-addons:2978603.name: Tab
firefox-addons:2978603.summary: Convert tabs into a list. Free 90% memory instantly!
firefox-addons:2978603.description: Whenever you find yourself with too many tabs, click the Tab Manager icon to convert all of your tabs into a list. When you need to access the tabs again, you can either restore them individually or all at once.

firefox-addons:2695397.name: Renewed Tab - New Tab with Widgets
firefox-addons:2695397.summary: See the weather, news, RSS, to-do lists and more on every New Tab page
firefox-addons:2695397.description:
Features 
 Drag and Drop Widgets : you can add, move, resize, and configure widgets on a grid using intuitive controls.
 Beautiful Backgrounds : see a random curated background every 15 minutes. You can also choose a solid color, an Unsplash collection, an RSS/Atom feed, or a custom background image.
 Customisable : change the background, the theme, and configure each widget independently.
 Multi-lingual : supports French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Malay, and Turkish. Translations are community-maintained allowing users to contribute support for their language.
 Widgets 
 RSS and Atom feeds : can be used to see the news or follow a website.
 Weather 
 To do list : track things you need to do.
 Quick Links : show links, with optional icons and subheadings.
 Top Sites : shows your most frequent websites.
 Daily Goals : enter a daily goal.
 Bookmarks : shows bookmarks from the bookmark toolbar.
 Greeting : be greeted based on the time of day.
 Quotes : shows a random quote, with categories.
 Clock : show the current time, choose between 12 and 24 hours.
 Notes : jot down notes in a freeform text area.
 Age : shows your current age with way too much precision.
 Search : a search bar, with support for changing the search engine.
 Web Comics : show the most recent panel from a web comic.
 Year Progress : shows the progress through the year as a progress bar.
 Currencies : shows exchange rates, supporting forex currencies and crypto.
 Upcoming Space Flights 
 and more: buttons, images, HTML, and iframes.
 Privacy Oriented 
We require only minimal permissions; other permissions are optional and only requested when needed. All your data is stored in your browser, not on our servers. 
 Support 
Need help? Found a bug, or have a request? Check out the Help and FAQ page to see common questions and to get in contact.

firefox-addons:3033793.name: quick tab sampler
firefox-addons:3033793.summary: Record, trim, and export audio directly from any browser tab. Clean, fast, and fully local.
firefox-addons:3033793.description:
Tab Sampler
Sample and edit audio directly from your browser. Record, trim, and export audio from any Firefox tab. Clean, fast, and fully local nothing is uploaded, all processing happens on your machine.
Features
 One-click recording from any tab (toolbar popup)
Waveform editor with precision trimming down to the millisecond
Loop and reverse playback, plus destructive edits: trim, delete, silence, reverse, normalize, fade in/out with undo/redo
Export as WAV (16-bit or 32-bit float) or MP3 (128/192/320 kbps)
Sample rates up to 96 kHz (capture when the browser allows it, resampling on export always)
Stereo or mono recording
Recording library everything saved locally in IndexedDB for playback, editing, and download
Fully offline no network access, no telemetry
Thanks for downloading, make some cool stuff with it.

firefox-addons:3042062.name: X Theme Engine
firefox-addons:3042062.summary: Completely transform X with a fully-local and powerful custom theme studio. Fine-tune colors, typography, layouts, media, and distractions with per-page themes, automation, Media Gate, and focus controls.
firefox-addons:3042062.description:
X Theme Engine gives you complete control over how X looks, feels, and behaves. Choose a ready-made theme or build a detailed custom palette, reduce distracting interface elements, and manage how media appears in your timeline.
Themes and Colors
Create a fully custom color palette or choose from 20 pre-made themes
Customize backgrounds, surfaces, cards, text, borders, accents, buttons, tabs, engagement controls, usernames, links, hashtags, and mentions.
Assign different themes to Home, Explore, Notifications, Messages, Grok, Bookmarks, profiles, Settings, and Creator Studio.
Typography and Layout
Choose from 26 font options.
Adjust text size and line height.
Change feed width and interface corner styling.
Create independently rounded post cards.
Select Circle, Soft, Squircle, Square, Hexagon, or Diamond avatar shapes.
Customize scrollbar width, thumb color, and track color.
Enable reduced-motion styling.
Media Controls
Use Media Gate to obscure timeline images and videos until you choose to reveal them.
Reveal individual posts with one click or reveal all media for the current session.
Optionally preview gated media on hover.
Control the strength of the gate blur.
Automatically pause and mute gated video and audio.
Adjust media brightness, grayscale, opacity, and saturation.
Focus Controls
Remove individual parts of X without hiding the content you still want:
Right sidebar
Trends and Today’s News
Who to follow
Premium and Verified Organizations links
Grok controls
Promoted posts and sponsored modules
Post composer and Post buttons
View counts and analytics actions
Reply, repost, and like counts
Profiles and Sharing
Export and import your complete settings profile.
Generate compact theme codes for sharing custom color palettes.
Import shared theme codes without using an external service.
Privacy
X Theme Engine contains no analytics, tracking, advertising, or external network requests. It only requests Firefox’s storage permission to save your preferences through extension storage.

firefox-addons:3030143.name: Claude Studio — RTL, Fonts & Themes
firefox-addons:3030143.summary: RTL & multilingual support for Claude: 50+ fonts, pro typography, light/dark/black themes, accent colors, and correct math & code.
firefox-addons:3030143.description:
Make Claude truly yours. Claude Studio restyles claude.ai and claude.com with first-class right-to-left support, beautiful multilingual fonts, professional typography, and rich theming — all from a clean popup with a live preview.
Whether you chat in Persian, Arabic, Hebrew, or Urdu, switch languages mid-conversation, or simply want Claude to look and read better, Claude Studio gives you precise control — without changing anything you don't want to touch.
🌐 Right-to-left, done right
• Full RTL layout for Claude's interface and messages
• "Auto" direction sets each message — even each block — from its own content, perfect for bilingual chats
• Math (KaTeX) and code always stay left-to-right and intact, so nothing breaks
• Localized digits (e.g. ۱۲۳) in conversations and the chat list, while your input and code stay untouched
🔤 Fonts & typography
• 50+ curated fonts, grouped by script — pick separate fonts for body text, headings, and code
• Fine-tune weight, size, line height, letter spacing, word spacing, and paragraph spacing
• Text alignment: right, left, center, or justify
• Limit the reading width for comfortable reading on wide screens
🎨 Themes & colors
• Light, Dark, and a true Black theme
• Set Claude's accent/highlight color and the code-box theme to match your taste
🎯 Precise scope
• Choose exactly what gets styled — Claude's replies, your messages, the composer, and the chat list — each independently
⚙️ Power-user tools
• Save, apply, and manage presets
• Add your own custom CSS
• Export and import all your settings
• Keyboard shortcuts to toggle the extension and open settings
• A 25-language interface with a live preview of every change
🔒 Private by design
• No accounts, no tracking, no data collection — your settings stay in your browser. (Fonts load on demand from Google Fonts.)
💻 Open source
• Free and open source — view the code, report issues, or contribute on GitHub: https://github.com/ILYAGVC/Claude-Studio (MIT License).
———
Claude Studio is an independent, unofficial extension. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic. "Claude" is a trademark of Anthropic.
